title: 1.5 Inverse Functions and Their Graphs
description: Inverse functions, invertibility, and graphs of inverse functions

questions.question: A function $f$ is called invertible if:
options: its inverse is also a function
its graph passes the vertical line test
it is defined for all real numbers
its range is equal to its domain
questions.correctAnswer: its inverse is also a function

questions.question: The notation $f^{-1}(x)$ is read as:
